item.title: Historic Virginia school for Black children reopens as museum after $6.2m restoration
item.description: The historic Union Street School in Leesburg, Virginia has reopened as a museum and community centre. From double bookings to health and safety embarrassments, we look back at how not to do it And then there were five. While nothing has been officially announced, it is widely understood that the shortlist to replace Daniel Craig as James Bond is now down to a handful of actors: Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor, Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult. The hunt for a new Bond comes at a propitious moment for the franchise as a whole, 25 films in (not counting the two “unofficial” entries, Casino… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Pulver

item.title: El personaje con el que Johnny Depp busca la redención en su regreso al cine tras el polémico juicio contra su exesposa Amber Heard
item.description: Johnny Depp interpreta a Scrooge en "Ebenezer", su primera película para un gran estudio desde los juicios por difamación en torno a su relación con Amber Heard. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.title: France remembers victims of 2015 Paris terror attacks
item.description: France on Friday marks 11 years since the 2015 Paris terror attacks, in which more than 130 were killed as gunmen and suicide bombers attacked the Bataclan concert hall, a major stadium, restaurants and bars. France 24’s James André reports from outside the Bataclan where a tribute to the victims is being held. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Cairo Film Festival opens as Middle East war weighs on cinema
item.description: The 47th Cairo International Film Festival got underway on Wednesday in the Egyptian capital. The event brings together filmmakers, actors and other prominent figures from around the world. This year’s festival is taking place under the shadow of the Middle East war. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Heartland review – Jessica Chastain’s Netflix country music thriller is more miss than hit
item.description: The Oscar winner plays a singer turned detective searching for her niece in an overly generic Nashville-based mystery that fails to find its footing Given the popularity of its music and the streaming services’ interest in faith-based programming, I’m always a little surprised that there aren’t more movies and TV shows about Nashville. Well, at least the idea of Nashville, the country music mecca that is perpetually struggling to define itself within and against the country at large, a place that has always been more diverse than its reputation yet still stands for a certain image of white… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Adrian Horton

item.title: Snoh Aalegra: Legendary Love review – raw R&B talent restrained by reverence for the greats
item.description: (Stem) Her truly remarkable, Sade-ish voice is hypnotic against some dizzyingly plush production, but a modern spin on 80s pastiche sometimes veers too close to tribute Swedish-Iranian singer Snoh Aalegra has previously described her music – a lush, pastiche-y mix of R&B, hip-hop, soul and pop – as “cinematic soul”. But although she’s a dab hand at graceful, timeless presentation (and has a truly remarkable voice) Aalegra’s music has often struggled to match up to its aesthetic, hampered by her love of the greats and a penchant for broadly generic lyrics. Her most recent album, 2021’s… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Shaad D'Souza

item.title: Who will inherit 007's licence to thrill? 'The world is not enough' in the hunt for James Bond
item.description: More than six decades after James Bond first appeared on the big screen, the search for Daniel Craig's successor has become a revealing debate about the future of one of cinema's most enduring, and endearing, franchises. "From the cold-blooded sexual magnetism of Sean Connery to the more tongue-in-cheek take of Roger Moore, to Daniel Craig's gritty realism, there's really a James Bond for everyone." But who will inherit the licence to thrill? FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell takes us on this exciting edge-of-your-seat adventure with a "view to a kill". Should Bond remain faithful to his… Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Informe desde Antigua: vuelven a Guatemala restos del nobel de literatura Miguel Ángel Asturias
item.description: Los restos del nobel de literatura Miguel Ángel Asturias vuelven a Guatemala tras 52 años. Las cenizas del escritor habían permanecido en Francia por solicitud de su familia debido a un exilio forzoso de más de 12 años durante el golpe de Estado de 1954 en el que perdió su nacionalidad. Amplía la información nuestro corresponsal Andrés Suárez Jaramillo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24
